text: Over the last 30 days, visitors have noted issues related to food quality and wait times at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Four reviews mentioned food quality, and three pointed out wait times, suggesting these areas may need attention. Service was mentioned in two reviews, while atmosphere was noted once. Overall, the average rating remains high with no critical reviews during this period.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was backed up and only grab-and-go options were offered late in the day. Many found the food quality disappointing, describing portions as small and prices as high relative to the experience. There were also complaints about the menu choices and preparation, including sandwiches that did not meet expectations. While the library itself received positive mentions, the café’s food and service need attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service problems included long wait times and inconsistent availability of menu items, leading some visitors to rely solely on grab-and-go options. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the food and dining experience are areas that need attention to better meet visitor expectations.
